{"id":"mimid-1wgh.37.90.14","title":"wg: virtual-clients-01 L853 A resync external Commit (Variant B, Joining externally step 3.2)...","description":"draft-ietf-mls-virtual-clients (virtual-clients-01), Externally joining groups with the virtual client / Adding an emulator client (Variant B). Editors' copy mlswg/mls-virtual-clients at 65e960d, L853.

Text: "If the virtual client was already a member of the
group, the other emulator clients hold the group's state and process the
external Commit like any other handshake message."

Problem: A resync external Commit (Variant B, Joining externally step 3.2) removes the leaf that all existing emulator clients share. Under RFC 9420 §12.4.2 each of them must conclude it was removed and drop the group. The draft gives no rule for staying in the group, moving to the new leaf index, and re-deriving its keys. The same text is in -01.

Suggested fix: Specify that an emulator client that processes an external Commit whose resync Remove targets the virtual client's leaf, and whose new LeafNode carries a valid DerivationInfo from its own emulation group, does not treat itself as removed. It moves to the new leaf, re-derives the leaf and path private keys from the DerivationInfo, and uses external_init_secret.

Severity: high. Verifier: keep (Confirmed. In Variant B (L1063-1065, L1345-1348) the external Commit removes the virtual client's prior leaf, which every existing emulator client occupies. RFC 9420 §12.4.2 says a client that receives a Commit removing it 'cannot send any more messages in the group and SHOULD promptly delete its group state'. L853-855 says to process the Commit 'like any other handshake message', and L637-640 covers only the init secret. No rule keeps existing emulator clients in the group or moves them to the new leaf. Open PR #30 adds only an epoch-ordering check.)
